definitions.explanation: Young sprouted beans, most commonly mung bean sprouts. A staple inexpensive vegetable in Japanese cooking.

examples.japanese: もやし⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{炒|いた}める→炒める：01879_itameru⟧。
もやし⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{安|やす}い→安い：00464_yasui⟧⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧だ。
examples.english: Bean sprouts are a very cheap vegetable.

examples.japanese: ⟦ラーメン→ラーメン：05181_raamen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧もやし⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦たっぷり→たっぷり：03404_tappuri⟧⟦{乗|の}っていた→乗る：00511_noru⟧。
examples.english: There was a generous pile of bean sprouts on top of the ramen.

notes:
WRITING:
Usually written in hiragana. The kanji {萌|もや}し exists but is not commonly used.

CULTURAL NOTE:
One of the cheapest vegetables available at Japanese supermarkets, often used in stir-fries, ramen, and namul. Known as a go-to ingredient for budget cooking.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- もやし{炒|いた}め (stir-fried bean sprouts)
- もやし⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ナムル→ナムル：16310_namuru⟧ (bean sprout namul)
- もやし⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{茹|ゆ}でる→茹でる：02324_yuderu⟧ (to boil bean sprouts)

SLANG:
もやしっ{子|こ} refers to a weak, skinny person (like a bean sprout).
